# から・ので・し — reason connectives

**[から (reason)](<../grammar/kara.md#reason> "Because; gives a reason.")**
:   The direct, subjective 'because' — states your reason plainly: 時間がないから、行かない。Fine among equals; can sound assertive in requests.

**[ので (reason)](<../grammar/node.md#reason> "Because or since; gives a softer, more explanatory reason")**
:   The softer, explanatory 'because' — presents the reason as circumstance: 時間がないので、失礼します。Preferred in polite requests and explanations.

**[し (reason listing)](<../grammar/shi.md#reason-listing> "Lists one or more reasons, suggesting additional reasons may also exist")**
:   Stacks reasons and implies there are more: 安いし、近いし、この店にしよう。Reach for it when one reason is not the whole story.
